{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas, cast to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check that the filter worked
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}")"}
